title: Start screen: install notice, update keys overlay, plugins and jev status
what:
panes/home.js install block, from GET /hub/install:
- notice: 'Minerva 0.2.0 available — run: hoot update'
- 'no installed Minerva here (development server)' / 'managed by Nix: update through nix'
- plugins: 'installed by Minerva: browser 0.x (stock) …', with the tail 'trust and service state are not recorded here'
- jev: 'not set up' | 'set up, not running' | 'running (pid N)', plus 'the openjev weights are not tracked'
`[ update keys ]` opens install/keys.js in the overlay:
- a list (id, fingerprint, source, expires)
- paste a .pub, then `[ inspect ]`: the fingerprint large in 4 groups of 4, with id and comment (comment as untrusted text)
- type the fingerprint back
- the step-up line per D4: 'in a terminal: hoot keys allow-web 0F7A 3A5C 447E C7EF (valid 2 minutes)'
- `[ add key ]` and the result sentence
- 'compare with the maintainer's published fingerprint, not only this page'
- 'agents run as you: an agent can add a key through the CLI without this page; Minerva's guard rows only slow that down'
- `[ remove ]` on keys added by hand only (ruling 6), under the same step-up
Never update.
tests:
keys.test.mjs:
- fingerprint normalization (spaces and case ignored) and the comparison helper
- a wrong fingerprint never enables `[ add key ]`
- remove is shown only for 'added by hand'
live_check: fake perch on PORT=48131 with fake_minerva in installed mode (the full add with an arm made by curl as the bearer) and not-installed mode.
risk: If a script in the page's origin rewrites the fingerprint shown, every guard confirms the attacker's key. The page says to compare out of band.
